algorithm: preselect up to 1/2/4 distinct existing public groups using one solved snapshot; atomically commit after full restarted CFR
fallback: cadence1 exact same-work differential; no naive regret warm start
limits: pending batch budget failure returns previous compiled tree/policy/counters; attempted work remains charged
comparison: cadence1 same work; cadence2/4 complete same finite game and semantic policy, NOT same work or same partial tree
oracle: 24 existing generated games x full/cadence2/4/partial budgets = 168 LP certificates plus pending-batch rollback
baseline: frozen S18 4 threads for five measured fixture families; pivot sequential. Both sides use identical storage/thread settings. Explicit experimental settings, not a production classifier.
